manifest.policy: Original square points exactly; annular counts matched within 3% and below 100k. Same per-class solver coverage as the prior study: high diffusion ASM24/AMG-Jacobi/native hp; transport ASM24/AMG-DILU/direct DILU; anisotropy ASM48/AMG-Jacobi. All AMG outer-method pairs share their preconditioner. Serial synchronized FP64 jobs, explicit zero guesses, one warmup plus three measured fresh setups, two solves/setup. Failures retained. Existing square n64/p6 outcomes reused; no 22,825-triangle job is run.

orchestration_revisions.reason: Restrict prior-square cache reuse to cases actually present in the previous campaign; no numerical worker/configuration changes or repeated completed solves.

2048.note: Affine triangles; sampled polygonal outer wall and polygonal approximation to circular hole. Exact Dirichlet trace is imposed on every discrete boundary edge.
2048.selection: Closest canonical Gmsh mesh within 3% of the prior square count, at most 100,000 triangles. The coarsest polygon has 220 outer segments because 400 segments force over 3,000 triangles; other levels retain 400.
